1	import { z } from "zod";
2	
3	const CATEGORIES = ["skills", "mcp", "slash", "plugins"] as const;
4	const SCOPES = ["personal", "org", "enterprise"] as const;
5	const FUNC_CATS = ["workTask", "business", "tools"] as const;
6	const FILTER_CHIPS = ["all", "trending", "new", "official", "free"] as const;
7	const SORTS = ["downloads", "stars", "recent"] as const;
8	const TAG_MATCHES = ["any", "all"] as const;
9	
10	export const PAGE_SIZE = 24;
11	
12	export const filtersSchema = z.object({
13	  q: z.string().trim().min(1).max(120).optional(),
14	  category: z.enum(CATEGORIES).optional(),
15	  scope: z.enum(SCOPES).optional(),
16	  funcCat: z.enum(FUNC_CATS).optional(),
17	  subCat: z.string().trim().min(1).max(40).optional(),
18	  l2: z.string().trim().min(1).max(40).optional(),
19	  // Department id (dotted-path) or the literal "__all" to disable the filter.
20	  dept: z.string().trim().min(1).max(120).optional(),
21	  // Creator = users.id (the user who published). Schema column is named
22	  // publisherUserId for legacy reasons; we expose it as "creator" everywhere.
23	  creator: z.string().trim().min(1).max(80).optional(),
24	  // Publisher = organizations.id (the owning org).
25	  publisher: z.string().trim().min(1).max(80).optional(),
26	  tags: z.array(z.string().trim().min(1).max(40)).max(16).optional(),
27	  tagMatch: z.enum(TAG_MATCHES).optional(),
28	  filter: z.enum(FILTER_CHIPS).optional(),
29	  sort: z.enum(SORTS).optional(),
30	  page: z.coerce.number().int().min(1).max(1000).optional(),
31	});
32	
33	export type Filters = z.infer<typeof filtersSchema>;
34	
35	/**
36	 * Parse Next.js searchParams into typed Filters. Invalid input is dropped,
37	 * so a malformed URL silently falls back to "no filter" rather than 500ing.
38	 */
39	export function parseFilters(
40	  input: Record<string, string | string[] | undefined>,
41	): Filters {
42	  const tags = input.tags;
43	  const normalized = {
44	    ...input,
45	    tags:
46	      tags === undefined
47	        ? undefined
48	        : Array.isArray(tags)
49	          ? tags
50	          : tags.split(",").filter(Boolean),
51	  };
52	  const parsed = filtersSchema.safeParse(normalized);
53	  return parsed.success ? parsed.data : {};
54	}
55	
56	export function pageOffset(page: number | undefined) {
57	  return ((page ?? 1) - 1) * PAGE_SIZE;
58	}
59	
60	/**
61	 * Adapter from `URLSearchParams` (the runtime shape) to the `Record` shape
62	 * `parseFilters` consumes. Repeated keys (`?tags=a&tags=b`) accumulate into
63	 * an array; `serializeFilters` always emits comma-joined, but external
64	 * links may use the array form and the validator already handles both.
65	 */
66	export function searchParamsToInput(
67	  searchParams: URLSearchParams,
68	): Record<string, string | string[]> {
69	  const out: Record<string, string | string[]> = {};
70	  for (const [key, value] of searchParams.entries()) {
71	    const prev = out[key];
72	    if (prev === undefined) {
73	      out[key] = value;
74	    } else if (Array.isArray(prev)) {
75	      prev.push(value);
76	    } else {
77	      out[key] = [prev, value];
78	    }
79	  }
80	  return out;
81	}
82	
83	/**
84	 * Inverse of `parseFilters`. Encodes typed filters back into URL search
85	 * params using the same conventions parseFilters consumes — comma-joined
86	 * arrays for `tags`, omitted keys for undefined / empty values.
87	 */
88	export function serializeFilters(filters: Partial<Filters>): URLSearchParams {
89	  const params = new URLSearchParams();
90	  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(filters)) {
91	    if (value === undefined || value === "" || value === null) continue;
92	    if (Array.isArray(value)) {
93	      if (value.length > 0) params.set(key, value.join(","));
94	    } else {
95	      params.set(key, String(value));
96	    }
97	  }
98	  return params;
99	}
100

61	export function findDept(
62	  id: string,
63	  list: Department[] = DEPARTMENTS,
64	): Department | null {
65	  for (const d of list) {
66	    if (d.id === id) return d;
67	    if (d.children) {
68	      const found = findDept(id, d.children);
69	      if (found) return found;
70	    }
71	  }
72	  return null;

75	export function deptPath(id: string, locale: Locale): string[] {
76	  const parts = id.split(".");
77	  const path: string[] = [];
78	  for (let i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) {
79	    const d = findDept(parts.slice(0, i + 1).join("."));
80	    if (d) path.push(locale === "zh" ? d.nameZh : d.name);
81	  }
82	  return path;
83	}
84	
85	export function isDescendant(deptId: string, ancestorId: string): boolean {
86	  return deptId === ancestorId || deptId.startsWith(ancestorId + ".");

1	import { desc, eq, sql } from "drizzle-orm";
2	
3	import { db } from "@/lib/db/client";
4	import { extensions, extensionTags, tags } from "@/lib/db/schema";
5	
6	export interface TagWithCount {
7	  id: string;
8	  labelEn: string;
9	  labelZh: string;
10	  count: number;
11	}
12	
13	export async function getTagsWithCounts(): Promise<TagWithCount[]> {
14	  const rows = await db
15	    .select({
16	      id: tags.id,
17	      labelEn: tags.labelEn,
18	      labelZh: tags.labelZh,
19	      // Count how many *published* extensions use this tag.
20	      count: sql<number>`count(${extensionTags.extensionId})::int`,
21	    })
22	    .from(tags)
23	    .leftJoin(extensionTags, eq(extensionTags.tagId, tags.id))
24	    .leftJoin(
25	      extensions,
26	      eq(extensions.id, extensionTags.extensionId),
27	    )
28	    .where(
29	      sql`${extensions.id} IS NULL OR ${extensions.visibility} = 'published'`,
30	    )
31	    .groupBy(tags.id)
32	    .orderBy(desc(sql`count(${extensionTags.extensionId})`));
33	
34	  // Drop tags with zero usage from the picker.
35	  return rows.filter((r) => r.count > 0);
36	}
37

  "content": "import { count, desc, eq, sql } from \"drizzle-orm\"\n\nimport { useDb } from \"~~/server/utils/db\"\nimport { users } from \"~~/shared/db/schema/auth\"\nimport { extensions, extensionTags, tags } from \"~~/shared/db/schema/extension\"\nimport { organizations } from \"~~/shared/db/schema/org\"\n\nexport interface CreatorFacet {\n  id: string\n  name: string | null\n  email: string\n  count: number\n}\n\nexport interface PublisherFacet {\n  id: string\n  name: string\n  nameZh: string | null\n  slug: string\n  count: number\n}\n\nexport interface TagFacet {\n  id: string\n  labelEn: string\n  labelZh: string\n  count: number\n}\n\nexport async function listPublishedCreators(): Promise<CreatorFacet[]> {\n  const db = useDb()\n  return db\n    .select({\n      id: users.id,\n      name: users.name,\n      email: users.email,\n      count: count(extensions.id),\n    })\n    .from(extensions)\n    .innerJoin(users, eq(users.id, extensions.publisherUserId))\n    .where(eq(extensions.visibility, \"published\"))\n    .groupBy(users.id)\n    .orderBy(desc(count(extensions.id)), users.email)\n}\n\nexport async function listPublishedPublishers(): Promise<PublisherFacet[]> {\n  const db = useDb()\n  return db\n    .select({\n      id: organizations.id,\n      name: organizations.name,\n      nameZh: organizations.nameZh,\n      slug: organizations.slug,\n      count: count(extensions.id),\n    })\n    .from(extensions)\n    .innerJoin(organizations, eq(organizations.id, extensions.ownerOrgId))\n    .where(eq(extensions.visibility, \"published\"))\n    .groupBy(organizations.id)\n    .orderBy(desc(count(extensions.id)), organizations.name)\n}\n\nexport async function listTagsWithCounts(): Promise<TagFacet[]> {\n  const db = useDb()\n  const rows = await db\n    .select({\n      id: tags.id,\n      labelEn: tags.labelEn,\n      labelZh: tags.labelZh,\n      count: sql<number>`count(${extensionTags.extensionId})::int`,\n    })\n    .from(tags)\n    .leftJoin(extensionTags, eq(extensionTags.tagId, tags.id))\n    .leftJoin(extensions, eq(extensions.id, extensionTags.extensionId))\n    .where(\n      sql`${extensions.id} IS NULL OR ${extensions.visibility} = 'published'`,\n    )\n    .groupBy(tags.id)\n    .orderBy(desc(sql`count(${extensionTags.extensionId})`))\n\n  // Drop tags with zero usage from the picker.\n  return rows.filter((r) => r.count > 0)\n}\n"
}

'border-(--color-accent) bg-(--color-accent)/10 text-(--color-accent)'\n            : 'border-(--color-border) text-(--color-ink-muted) hover:text-(--color-ink)'\"\n          @click=\"selectDept(undefined)\"\n        >\n          {{ t(\"filters.dept.all\") }}\n        </button>\n      </div>\n\n      <div class=\"max-h-72 overflow-y-auto py-1\">\n        <div\n          v-for=\"row in visibleRows\"\n          :key=\"row.dept.id\"\n          class=\"flex items-center\"\n          :style=\"{ paddingLeft: `${8 + row.depth * 14}px` }\"\n        >\n          <button\n            v-if=\"row.dept.children && row.dept.children.length\"\n            type=\"button\"\n            class=\"grid size-5 place-items-center rounded text-(--color-ink-muted) hover:text-(--color-ink)\"\n            :aria-label=\"expanded.has(row.dept.id)\n              ? t('filters.dept.collapse')\n              : t('filters.dept.expand')\"\n            @click=\"toggleExpand(row.dept.id)\"\n          >\n            <ChevronDown v-if=\"expanded.has(row.dept.id)\" :size=\"12\" aria-hidden=\"true\" />\n            <ChevronRight v-else :size=\"12\" aria-hidden=\"true\" />\n          </button>\n          <span v-else class=\"block size-5\" />\n          <button\n            type=\"button\"\n            class=\"flex flex-1 items-center justify-between gap-2 rounded-sm px-2 py-1 text-left text-sm hover:bg-(--color-sidebar)\"\n            :class=\"filters.dept === row.dept.id\n              ?   "content": "<script setup lang=\"ts\">\nimport { ChevronDown } from \"lucide-vue-next\"\nimport type { Locale, TagFacet } from \"~~/shared/types\"\nimport { tagLabel } from \"~~/shared/tags\"\n\nconst props = defineProps<{\n  tags: TagFacet[]\n}>()\n\nconst { t, locale } = useI18n()\nconst { filters, update } = useFilters()\n\nconst TAG_COLLAPSE_LIMIT = 14\n\nconst open = ref(false)\nconst showAll = ref(false)\n\nconst activeTags = computed<string[]>(() => filters.value.tags ?? [])\nconst matchMode = computed(() => filters.value.tagMatch ?? \"any\")\n\nconst visibleTags = computed(() => {\n  if (showAll.value) return props.tags\n  return props.tags.slice(0, TAG_COLLAPSE_LIMIT)\n})\nconst hiddenCount = computed(() => Math.max(0, props.tags.length - TAG_COLLAPSE_LIMIT))\n\nfunction toggleTag(id: string) {\n  const set = new Set(activeTags.value)\n  if (set.has(id)) set.delete(id)\n  else set.add(id)\n  const next = Array.from(set)\n  update({ tags: next.length ? next : undefined })\n}\n\nfunction setMatch(mode: \"any\" | \"all\") {\n  update({ tagMatch: mode === \"any\" ? undefined : mode })\n}\n\nfunction clearTags() {\n  update({ tags: undefined, tagMatch: undefined })\n}\n\nfunction labelFor(id: string): string {\n  return tagLabel(id, locale.value as Locale)\n}\n</script>\n\n<template>\n  <div class=\"w-full\">\n    <button\n      type=\"button\"\n      class=\"inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-md border px-2.5 py-1 text-[12px] transition-colors\"\n      :class=\"activeTags.length\n        ? 'border-(--color-accent)/40 bg-(--color-accent)/10 text-(--color-accent)'\n        : 'border-(--color-border) bg-(--color-card) text-(--color-ink-muted) hover:text-(--color-ink)'\"\n      :aria-expanded=\"open\"\n      @click=\"open = !open\"\n    >\n      <span class=\"font-semibold\">{{ t(\"filters.tagsToggle\") }}</span>\n      <span\n        v-if=\"activeTags.length\"\n        class=\"rounded-full bg-(--color-accent) text-(--color-accent-fg) font-mono text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.5\"\n      >\n        {{ activeTags.length }}\n      </span>\n      <ChevronDown\n        :size=\"12\"\n        :class=\"['transition-transform', open ? '' : '-rotate-90']\"\n        aria-hidden=\"true\"\n      />\n    </button>\n\n    <div v-if=\"open\" class=\"mt-3 rounded-md border border-(--color-border) bg-(--color-card) p-3\">\n      <div class=\"flex flex-wrap gap-1.5\">\n        <button\n          v-for=\"tag in visibleTags\"\n          :key=\"tag.id\"\n          type=\"button\"\n          class=\"inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full border px-2 py-0.5 text-[11px] transition-colors\"\n          :class=\"activeTags.includes(tag.id)\n            ? 'border-(--color-accent) bg-(--color-accent) text-(--color-accent-fg)'\n            : 'border-(--color-border) text-(--color-ink-muted) hover:text-(--color-ink)'\"\n          @click=\"toggleTag(tag.id)\"\n        >\n          <span>{{ labelFor(tag.id) }}</span>\n          <span class=\"font-mono text-[10px] opacity-70\">{{ tag.count }}</span>\n        </button>\n      </div>\n\n      <div v-if=\"hiddenCount > 0\" class=\"mt-3 flex justify-center\">\n        <button\n          type=\"button\"\n          class=\"text-[11px] text-(--color-ink-muted) hover:text-(--color-ink)\"\n          @click=\"showAll = !showAll\"\n        >\n          {{ showAll ? t(\"filters.showLess\") : t(\"filters.showMoreCount\", { count: hiddenCount }) }}\n        </button>\n      </div>\n\n      <div\n        v-if=\"activeTags.length\"\n        class=\"mt-3 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 border-t border-(--color-border) pt-3\"\n      >\n        <div class=\"flex items-center gap-2 text-[11px] text-(--color-ink-muted)\">\n          <span>{{ t(\"filters.matchModeGroupLabel\") }}:</span>\n          <div class=\"inline-flex overflow-hidden rounded-md border border-(--color-border)\">\n            <button\n              type=\"button\"\n              class=\"px-2 py-0.5 transition-colors\"\n              :class=\"matchMode === 'any'\n                ? 3	// Slug shape, exported so client-side form validators don't redefine it.
4	export const SLUG_PATTERN = /^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$/;

14	export const ExtensionManifestCore = z.object({

28	  description: z.string().min(1).max(280),

31	});
32	
33	// Permissions toggled in the wizard — surfaced on the detail page so users

35	export const PermissionsSchema = z
36	  .object({
37	    network: z.boolean().optional(),
38	    files: z.boolean().optional(),
39	    runtime: z.boolean().optional(),
40	    data: z.boolean().optional(),
41	  })
42	  .default({});

44	// Form: the slimmer field set the redesigned publish wizard collects.
45	// Notable departures from the prior form:
46	//   - `summary` (the design's one-line description, max 80) replaces the
47	//     long `description`/`descriptionZh` pair. Stored in the `tagline` column.
48	//   - `funcCat` / `subCat` / `l2` are gone from the wizard. Server-side
49	//     defaults (`defaultClassification`) backfill funcCat/subCat from the
50	//     chosen `category` so filters keep working.
51	//   - URL/license fields (homepageUrl, repoUrl, licenseSpdx) are dropped
52	//     from the wizard; the columns stay nullable in the DB.
53	//   - `iconColor`, `readmeMd`, `permissions`, `sourceMethod`, `taglineZh`
54	//     are new in the form and persist directly.
55	export const ManifestFormSchema = z.object({
56	  slug: ExtensionManifestCore.shape.slug,
57	  name: ExtensionManifestCore.shape.name,
58	  nameZh: ExtensionManifestCore.shape.nameZh,
59	  version: ExtensionManifestCore.shape.version,
60	  category: ExtensionManifestCore.shape.category,
61	  scope: ExtensionManifestCore.shape.scope,
62	  summary: z.string().min(1, "Required").max(SUMMARY_MAX),
63	  taglineZh: z.string().max(SUMMARY_MAX).optional(),
64	  // Bound the README so saveDraft + step transitions don't ship
65	  // arbitrarily large markdown payloads on every keystroke. 16k is
66	  // generous for an extension README without ballooning auto-save.
67	  readmeMd: z.string().max(16_000).optional(),
68	  iconColor: z
69	    .enum(["indigo", "amber", "emerald", "rose", "slate"])
70	    .default("indigo"),
71	  tagIds: z.array(z.string()).max(8),
72	  deptId: z.string().optional(),
73	  permissions: PermissionsSchema,
74	  sourceMethod: z.literal("zip").default("zip"),
75	});
76	
77	export type ManifestFormValues = z.infer<typeof ManifestFormSchema>;
78	
79	// Bundle: same fields as before, lifted into the [extension] /
80	// [categorization] TOML sections defined in docs/manifest-spec.md. The
81	// bundle manifest still carries description + funcCat + subCat — those
82	// come from whatever produced the bundle (CLI, hand-authored TOML), not
83	// from the publish wizard, so they remain required at the bundle layer.
84	export const BundleManifestSchema = z.object({
85	  extension: ExtensionManifestCore.pick({

89	    version: true,
90	    category: true,
91	    scope: true,
92	    description: true,
93	    descriptionZh: true,

98	    subCat: true,
99	    l2: true,
100	  }),
101	});
102	
103	export type BundleManifest = z.infer<typeof BundleManifestSchema>;

59	        id: extensionId,
60	        slug: data.slug,
61	        name: data.name,
62	        nameZh: emptyToNull(data.nameZh),
63	        tagline: data.summary,
64	        taglineZh: emptyToNull(data.taglineZh),
65	        category: data.category,
66	        scope: data.scope,
67	        funcCat: cls.funcCat,
68	        subCat: cls.subCat,
69	        deptId: emptyToNull(data.deptId),
70	        iconColor: data.iconColor,
71	        readmeMd: emptyToNull(data.readmeMd ?? ""),
72	        permissions: data.permissions ?? {},
73	        publisherUserId: userId,
74	        ownerOrgId: DEFAULT_ORG_ID,
75	        visibility: "draft",
76	      })
77	      await tx.insert(extensionVersions).values({
78	        id: versionId,
79	        extensionId,
80	        version: data.version,
81	        status: "pending",
82	        sourceMethod: data.sourceMethod,
83	      })
84	      if (data.tagIds.length > 0) {
85	        await tx.insert(extensionTags).values(
86	          data.tagIds.map((tagId) => ({ extensionId, tagId })),
87	        )
88	      }
89	    })
90	  } catch (err) {
91	    console.error("[publish] createDraftExtension failed", err)
92	    const message = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err)
93	    if (message.includes("extensions_slug_unique") || message.includes("duplicate key")) {
94	      return { ok: false, error: "slug_taken" }
95	    }
96	    return { ok: false, error: "db_error", detail: message }
97	  }
98	  return { ok: true, extensionId, versionId }
99	}

101	export type AttachFileResult =
102	  | { ok: true; fileId: string }
103	  | { ok: false; error: string }
104	
105	export async function attachFile(
106	  userId: string,
107	  versionId: string,
108	  r2Key: string,
109	  size: number,
110	  checksumSha256: string,
111	): Promise<AttachFileResult> {
112	  const fileId = crypto.randomUUID()
113	  const db = useDb()
114	
115	  const [owner] = await db
116	    .select({ publisherUserId: extensions.publisherUserId })
117	    .from(extensionVersions)
118	    .innerJoin(extensions, eq(extensions.id, extensionVersions.extensionId))
119	    .where(eq(extensionVersions.id, versionId))
120	    .limit(1)
121	  if (!owner || owner.publisherUserId !== userId) {
122	    return { ok: false, error: "not_found" }
123	  }
124	
125	  try {
126	    await db.transaction(async (tx) => {
127	      await tx.insert(files).values({
128	        id: fileId,
129	        r2Key,
130	        size: BigInt(size),
131	        checksumSha256,
132	        mimeType: "application/zip",
133	        scanStatus: "pending",
134	      })
135	      const updated = await tx
136	        .update(extensionVersions)
137	        .set({ bundleFileId: fileId })
138	        .where(eq(extensionVersions.id, versionId))
139	        .returning({ id: extensionVersions.id })
140	      if (updated.length === 0) throw new Error("version_disappeared")
141	    })
142	  } catch (err) {
143	    console.error("[publish] attachFile failed", err)
144	    return { ok: false, error: "db_error" }
145	  }
146	  return { ok: true, fileId }
147	}

149	export type SubmitResult =
150	  | { ok: true }
151	  | { ok: false; error: string }
152	
153	export async function submitForReview(
154	  userId: string,
155	  versionId: string,
156	): Promise<SubmitResult> {
157	  const db = useDb()
158	  const [version] = await db
159	    .select({
160	      bundleFileId: extensionVersions.bundleFileId,
161	      publisherUserId: extensions.publisherUserId,
162	    })
163	    .from(extensionVersions)
164	    .innerJoin(extensions, eq(extensions.id, extensionVersions.extensionId))
165	    .where(eq(extensionVersions.id, versionId))
166	    .limit(1)
167	  if (!version || version.publisherUserId !== userId) {
168	    return { ok: false, error: "not_found" }
169	  }
170	  if (!version.bundleFileId) return { ok: false, error: "no_bundle" }
171	
172	  try {
173	    await submit(versionId)
174	  } catch (err) {
175	    if (err instanceof VersionStateError) {
176	      return { ok: false, error: "version_not_submittable" }
177	    }
178	    console.error("[publish] submitForReview failed", err)
179	    return { ok: false, error: "db_error" }
180	  }
181	
182	  try {
183	    const { inngest } = await import("~~/server/utils/inngest")
184	    await inngest.send({
185	      name: "extension/scan.requested",
186	      data: { versionId, fileId: version.bundleFileId },
187	    })
188	  } catch (err) {
189	    console.error("[publish] inngest.send failed", err)
190	    try {
191	      await db
192	        .update(extensionVersions)
193	        .set({ status: "pending" })
194	        .where(
195	          and(
196	            eq(extensionVersions.id, versionId),
197	            eq(extensionVersions.status, "scanning"),
198	          ),
199	        )
200	    } catch (rollbackErr) {
201	      console.error("[publish] rollback after inngest failure failed", rollbackErr)
202	    }
203	    return { ok: false, error: "scan_queue_unavailable" }
204	  }
205	  return { ok: true }
206	}
207	
208	export async function getMyExtensions(userId: string) {
209	  const db = useDb()
210	  const rows = await db
211	    .select({
212	      id: extensions.id,
213	      slug: extensions.slug,
214	      name: extensions.name,
215	      category: extensions.category,
216	      visibility: extensions.visibility,
217	      createdAt: extensions.createdAt,
218	      latestVersionId: extensionVersions.id,
219	      latestVersion: extensionVersions.version,
220	      latestStatus: extensionVersions.status,
221	      latestBundleFileId: extensionVersions.bundleFileId,
222	    })
223	    .from(extensions)
224	    .leftJoin(
225	      extensionVersions,
226	      eq(extensionVersions.extensionId, extensions.id),
227	    )
228	    .where(eq(extensions.publisherUserId, userId))
229	    .orderBy(desc(extensions.createdAt), desc(extensionVersions.createdAt))
230	
231	  const byExtension = new Map<string, (typeof rows)[number]>()
232	  for (const row of rows) {
233	    if (!byExtension.has(row.id)) byExtension.set(row.id, row)
234	  }
235	  return Array.from(byExtension.values())
236	}

238	export async function discardDraft(
239	  userId: string,
240	  extensionId: string,
241	): Promise<{ ok: true } | { ok: false; error: string }> {
242	  const db = useDb()
243	  const [row] = await db
244	    .select({
245	      publisherUserId: extensions.publisherUserId,
246	      visibility: extensions.visibility,
247	    })
248	    .from(extensions)
249	    .where(eq(extensions.id, extensionId))
250	    .limit(1)
251	
252	  if (!row || row.publisherUserId !== userId) {
253	    return { ok: false, error: "not_found" }
254	  }
255	  if (row.visibility !== "draft") {
256	    return { ok: false, error: "not_discardable" }
257	  }
258	
259	  await db.delete(extensions).where(eq(extensions.id, extensionId))
260	  return { ok: true }
261	}

null)\n  const versionId = ref<string | null>(init.versionId ?? null)\n  const bundleUploaded = ref(init.bundleUploaded ?? false)\n  const step = ref<WizardStep>(init.bundleUploaded ? 3 : init.extensionId ? 1 : 0)\n  const error = ref<WizardError | null>(null)\n  const busy = ref(false)\n\n  // Auto-derive slug from name as long as the user hasn't hand-edited slug.\n  // We track that by snapshotting the auto-derived value and only re-deriving\n  // when slug still matches the last auto-derived snapshot.\n  let lastAutoSlug = slugFromName(form.name)\n  watch(\n    () => form.name,\n    (name) => {\n      const next = slugFromName(name)\n      if (form.slug === lastAutoSlug || form.slug === \"\") {\n        form.slug = next\n        lastAutoSlug = next\n      }\n    },\n  )\n\n  const isLocked = computed(() => extensionId.value !== null)\n\n  // Per-step validity. Same gates as the original wizard.\n  const basicsValid = computed(() => {\n    if (form.name.length < 2 || form.name.length > 80) return false\n    if (!SLUG_PATTERN.test(form.slug) || form.slug.length < 3 || form.slug.length > 64) return false\n    if (!SEMVER_PATTERN.test(form.version)) return false\n    if (form.summary.length < 1 || form.summary.length > SUMMARY_MAX) return false\n    return true\n  })\n\n  const bundleValid = computed(() => bundleUploaded.value)\n\n  const listingValid = computed(() => {\n    if (form.tagIds.length === 0) return false\n    if ((form.readmeMd ?? \"\").length < 1) return false\n    return true\n  })\n\n  const canSubmit = computed(\n    () => basicsValid.value && bundleValid.value && listingValid.value,\n  )\n\n  function setError(msg: string, detail?: string) {\n    error.value = { msg, detail }\n  }\n\n  function clearError() {\n    error.value = null\n  }\n\n  // --- Step transitions ---\n\n  async function advanceFromBasics(): Promise<boolean> {\n    if (!basicsValid.value) return false\n    clearError()\n    busy.value = true\n    try {\n      if (!extensionId.value) {\n        const result = await $fetch<{ ok: true; extensionId: string; versionId: string }>(\n          \"/api/internal/publish/create-draft\",\n          { method: \"POST\", body: form },\n        )\n        extensionId.value = result.extensionId\n        versionId.value = result.versionId\n      } else {\n        await $fetch(\"/api/internal/publish/update-draft\", {\n          method: \"POST\",\n          body: { extensionId: extensionId.value, values: form },\n        })\n      }\n      step.value = 1\n      return true\n    } catch (err) {\n      const data = (err as { data?: { error?: string; detail?: string } })?.data\n      setError(data?.error ?? \"unknown_error\", data?.detail)\n      return false\n    } finally {\n      busy.value = false\n    }\n  }\n\n  function advanceFromBundle() {\n    if (!bundleValid.value) return false\n    step.value = 2\n    return true\n  }\n\n  function advanceFromListing() {\n    if (!listingValid.value) return false\n    step.value = 3\n    return true\n  }\n\n  async function submit(): Promise<boolean> {\n    if (!canSubmit.value || !extensionId.value || !versionId.value) return false\n    clearError()\n    busy.value = true\n    try {\n      // Final persistence in case Listing was edited after Review jump-back.\n      await $fetch(\"/api/internal/publish/update-draft\", {\n        method: \"POST\",\n        body: { extensionId: extensionId.value, values: form },\n      })\n      await $fetch(\"/api/internal/publish/submit\", {\n        method: \"POST\",\n        body: { versionId: versionId.value },\n      })\n      step.value = 4\n      return true\n    } catch (err) {\n      const data = (err as { data?: { error?: string; detail?: string }; statusMessage?: string })\n        ?.data\n      setError(\n        data?.error ?? (err as { statusMessage?: string })?.statusMessage ?? \"unknown_error\",\n        data?.detail,\n      )\n      return false\n    } finally {\n      busy.value = false\n    }\n  }\n\n  function jumpTo(target: WizardStep) {\n    step.value = target\n  }\n\n  function markBundleUploaded() {\n    bundleUploaded.value = true\n  }\n\n  return {\n    form,\n    step,\n    extensionId,\n    versionId,\n    bundleUploaded,\n    error,\n    busy,\n    isLocked,\n    basicsValid,\n    bundleValid,\n    listingValid,\n    canSubmit,\n    advanceFromBasics,\n    advanceFromBundle,\n    advanceFromListing,\n    submit,\n    jumpTo,\n    markBundleUploaded,\n    setError,\n    clearError,\n  }\n}\n\nexport type PublishWizard = ReturnType<typeof usePublishWizard>\n"
}

{
  "command": "git commit -m \"$(cat <<'EOF'\nfeat(p17-wizard): wizard state composable, live preview, and edit endpoints\n\nFoundations for the 4-step publish wizard (Basics → Bundle → Listing →\nReview). Step components and the wizard root land in the next commit; the\nedit/resume page in the one after.\n\n- app/composables/usePublishWizard.ts holds the wizard state machine:\n  a reactive ManifestFormValues, step/error/busy flags, per-step validity\n  computeds, and four async transitions (advanceFromBasics, advanceFromBundle,\n  advanceFromListing, submit). Basics-advance calls create-draft on first\n  pass or update-draft on subsequent passes so the user can hop back and\n  edit. submit calls update-draft then submit so any post-Review edits to\n  Listing are persisted before the version flips to scanning.\n- app/components/publish/PubField.vue + PubChoice.vue are the shared\n  form primitives the steps lean on (form-row wrapper + radio-style choice\n  card with check indicator), modelled on shared.tsx from the original.\n- app/components/publish/WizardLivePreview.vue mirrors the listing card and\n  derived manifest.json next to the wizard rail; pure-derived from the\n  reactive form, no fetches.\n- shared/data/icon-colors.ts: OKLCH palette used by both the preview and\n  the Listing step.\n- server/api/internal/publish/update-draft.post.ts +\n  server/api/internal/publish/get-draft.get.ts are new endpoints. The\n  matching updateDraftExtension + getDraftExtension functions in\n  server/utils/publish.ts enforce: owner check, slug + version are\n  immutable post-create, only `visibility === 'draft'` rows are editable.\n- Wizard i18n keys (steps, fields, hints, errors, success copy) added in\n  en.json + zh.json.\nEOF\n)\"",
  "description": "Commit P17 part 1"
}

wizard: PublishWizard }>()\n\nconst { t } = useI18n()\n\nconst MAX_SIZE = 50 * 1024 * 1024 // 50 MB\nconst fileInput = useTemplateRef<HTMLInputElement>(\"fileInput\")\nconst fileName = ref<string | null>(null)\nconst localError = ref<string | null>(null)\nconst uploading = ref(false)\n\nasync function sha256Hex(buf: ArrayBuffer): Promise<string> {\n  const hash = await crypto.subtle.digest(\"SHA-256\", buf)\n  return Array.from(new Uint8Array(hash))\n    .map((b) => b.toString(16).padStart(2, \"0\"))\n    .join(\"\")\n}\n\nasync function onFile(file: File) {\n  localError.value = null\n  if (!file.name.toLowerCase().endsWith(\".zip\")) {\n    localError.value = t(\"publish.wizard.bundle.wrongType\")\n    return\n  }\n  if (file.size > MAX_SIZE) {\n    localError.value = t(\"publish.wizard.bundle.tooLarge\")\n    return\n  }\n  if (!props.wizard.versionId.value || !props.wizard.extensionId.value) {\n    props.wizard.setError(\"no_draft\")\n    return\n  }\n\n  uploading.value = true\n  try {\n    const buf = await file.arrayBuffer()\n    const checksum = await sha256Hex(buf)\n\n    const signed = await $fetch<{ url: string; key: string }>(\n      \"/api/upload/sign\",\n      {\n        method: \"POST\",\n        body: {\n          slug: props.wizard.form.slug,\n          version: props.wizard.form.version,\n          contentType: \"application/zip\",\n        },\n      },\n    )\n\n    const put = await fetch(signed.url, {\n      method: \"PUT\",\n      headers: { \"Content-Type\": \"application/zip\" },\n      body: buf,\n    })\n    if (!put.ok) throw new Error(`upload failed: ${put.status}`)\n\n    await $fetch(\"/api/internal/publish/attach-file\", {\n      method: \"POST\",\n      body: {\n        versionId: props.wizard.versionId.value,\n        r2Key: signed.key,\n        size: file.size,\n        checksumSha256: checksum,\n      },\n    })\n\n    fileName.value = file.name\n    props.wizard.markBundleUploaded()\n  } catch (err) {\n    const data = (err as { data?: { error?: string }; statusMessage?: string })\n    localError.value = data?.data?.error ?? data?.statusMessage ?? t(\"publish.errors.generic\")\n  } finally {\n    uploading.value = false\n  }\n}\n\nfunction onFileChange(event: Event) {\n  const target = event.target as HTMLInputElement\n  const file = target.files?.[0]\n  if (file) onFile(file)\n}\n\nfunction onDrop(event: DragEvent) {\n  event.preventDefault()\n  const file = event.dataTransfer?.files?.[0]\n  if (file) onFile(file)\n}\n\nfunction pick() {\n  fileInput.value?.click()\n}\n</script>\n\n<template>\n  <div class=\"space-y-6\">\n    <header>\n      <h2 class=\"font-serif text-xl text-(--color-ink)\">{{ t(\"publish.wizard.bundle.title\") }}</h2>\n      <p class=\"mt-1 text-sm text-(--color-ink-muted)\">\n        {{ t(\"publish.wizard.bundle.subtitle\") }}\n      </p>\n    </header>\n\n    <div\n      class=\"rounded-(--radius-card) border-2 border-dashed border-(--color-border) bg-(--color-card) p-8 text-center transition-colors hover:border-(--color-accent)/40\"\n      @dragover.prevent\n      @drop=\"onDrop\"\n    >\n      <div v-if=\"wizard.bundleUploaded.value && fileName\" class=\"flex flex-col items-center gap-2\">\n        <Check class=\"size-8 text-(--color-accent)\" aria-hidden=\"true\" />\n        <p class=\"text-sm text-(--color-ink)\">\n          {{ t(\"publish.wizard.bundle.uploaded\", { name: fileName }) }}\n        </p>\n        <Button variant=\"outline\" size=\"sm\" @click=\"pick\">\n          {{ t(\"publish.wizard.bundle.replace\") }}\n        </Button>\n      </div>\n      <div v-else class=\"flex flex-col items-center gap-3\">\n        <Upload class=\"size-8 text-(--color-ink-muted)\" aria-hidden=\"true\" />\n        <p class=\"text-sm text-(--color-ink-muted)\">{{ t(\"publish.wizard.bundle.drop\") }}</p>\n        <p class=\"text-[11px] text-(--color-ink-muted)\">{{ t(\"publish.wizard.bundle.max\") }}</p>\n        <Button :disabled=\"uploading\" @click=\"pick\">\n          {{ uploading ? t(\"publish.stages.uploading\") : t(\"publish.fields.bundle\") }}\n        </Button>\n      </div>\n\n      <input\n        ref=\"fileInput\"\n        type=\"file\"\n        accept=\".zip,application/zip\"\n        class=\"hidden\"\n        @change=\"onFileChange\"\n      >\n    </div>\n\n    <p v-if=\"localError\" class=\"text-sm text-red-600\">{{ localError }}</p>\n  </div>\n</template>\n"
}

{
  "file_path": "/Users/hutusi/workspace/ai/naive/agentcenter-nuxt/app/components/publish/UploadWizard.vue",
  "content": "<script setup lang=\"ts\">\nimport type { WizardInit, WizardStep } from \"~/composables/usePublishWizard\"\nimport { usePublishWizard } from \"~/composables/usePublishWizard\"\n\nconst props = defineProps<{ init?: WizardInit }>()\n\nconst { t } = useI18n()\n\nconst wizard = usePublishWizard(props.init ?? {})\n\nconst STEPS: Array<{ index: WizardStep; key: string }> = [\n  { index: 0, key: \"basics\" },\n  { index: 1, key: \"bundle\" },\n  { index: 2, key: \"listing\" },\n  { index: 3, key: \"review\" },\n]\n\nconst nextDisabled = computed(() => {\n  if (wizard.busy.value) return true\n  if (wizard.step.value === 0) return !wizard.basicsValid.value\n  if (wizard.step.value === 1) return !wizard.bundleValid.value\n  if (wizard.step.value === 2) return !wizard.listingValid.value\n  if (wizard.step.value === 3) return !wizard.canSubmit.value\n  return true\n})\n\nasync function advance() {\n  if (wizard.step.value === 0) await wizard.advanceFromBasics()\n  else if (wizard.step.value === 1) wizard.advanceFromBundle()\n  else if (wizard.step.value === 2) wizard.advanceFromListing()\n  else if (wizard.step.value === 3) await wizard.submit()\n}\n\nfunction back() {\n  if (wizard.step.value > 0 && wizard.step.value <= 3) {\n    wizard.jumpTo((wizard.step.value - 1) as WizardStep)\n  }\n}\n\nfunction jumpTo(step: WizardStep) {\n  // Allow forward jumps only to already-valid earlier steps via the review screen.\n  wizard.jumpTo(step)\n}\n</script>\n\n<template>\n  <div class=\"grid gap-8 lg:grid-cols-[1fr_320px]\">\n    <div>\n      <!-- Step rail -->\n      <ol\n        v-if=\"wizard.step.value < 4\"\n        class=\"mb-6 flex items-center gap-2 text-[12px] text-(--color-ink-muted)\"\n      >\n        <li\n          v-for=\"(s, i) in STEPS\"\n          :key=\"s.key\"\n          class=\"flex items-center gap-2\"\n        >\n          <span\n            class=\"grid size-6 place-items-center rounded-full border text-[11px] font-mono\"\n            :class=\"wizard.step.value === s.index\n              ? 'border-(--color-accent) bg-(--color-accent) text-(--color-accent-fg)'\n              : wizard.step.value > s.index\n                ? 'border-(--color-accent) text-(--color-accent)'\n                : 'border-(--color-border)'\"\n          >\n            {{ i + 1 }}\n          </span>\n          <span :class=\"wizard.step.value === s.index ? 'text-(--color-ink) font-medium' : ''\">\n            {{ t(`publish.wizard.steps.${s.key}`) }}\n          </span>\n          <span v-if=\"i < STEPS.length - 1\" class=\"text-(--color-border)\">→</span>\n        </li>\n      </ol>\n\n      <!-- Steps -->\n      <WizardBasics v-if=\"wizard.step.value === 0\" :wizard=\"wizard\" />\n      <WizardBundle v-else-if=\"wizard.step.value === 1\" :wizard=\"wizard\" />\n      <WizardListing v-else-if=\"wizard.step.value === 2\" :wizard=\"wizard\" />\n      <WizardReview\n        v-else-if=\"wizard.step.value === 3\"\n        :wizard=\"wizard\"\n        @jump=\"jumpTo\"\n      />\n      <WizardSuccess v-else :wizard=\"wizard\" />\n\n      <!-- Error -->\n      <div\n        v-if=\"wizard.error.value\"\n        class=\"mt-4 rounded-md border border-red-300/40 bg-red-50/40 p-3 text-sm text-red-700 dark:bg-red-900/10\"\n      >\n        <p class=\"font-medium\">{{ t(`publish.errors.${wizard.error.value.msg}`, wizard.error.value.msg) }}</p>\n        <p v-if=\"wizard.error.value.detail\" class=\"mt-1 text-[12px]\">{{ wizard.error.value.detail }}</p>\n      </div>\n\n      <!-- Navigation -->\n      <div\n        v-if=\"wizard.step.value < 4\"\n        class=\"mt-8 flex items-center justify-between border-t border-(--color-border) pt-4\"\n      >\n        <Button\n          v-if=\"wizard.step.value > 0\"\n          variant=\"ghost\"\n          :disabled=\"wizard.busy.value\"\n          @click=\"back\"\n        >\n          {{ t(\"publish.wizard.back\") }}\n        </Button>\n        <span v-else />\n        <Button :disabled=\"nextDisabled\" @click=\"advance\">\n          {{\n            wizard.step.value === 3\n              ? t(\"publish.wizard.review.submit\")\n              : t(\"publish.wizard.next\")\n          }}\n        </Button>\n      </div>\n    </div>\n\n    <WizardLivePreview v-if=\"wizard.step.value < 4\" :form=\"wizard.form\" />\n  </div>\n</template>\n"
}

=== app/components/publish/WizardBundle.vue:85 ===
_⚠️ Potential issue_ | _🟡 Minor_ | _⚡ Quick win_

**Reset the file input value after handling selection.**

If a user picks the same `.zip` again (common after a failed upload), `change` may not fire because the input value didn’t change. Clear the input value after reading the file.

 

<details>
<summary>Suggested fix</summary>

```diff
 function onFileChange(event: Event) {
   const target = event.target as HTMLInputElement
   const file = target.files?.[0]
   if (file) onFile(file)
+  target.value = ""
 }

**Preserve backend error status instead of forcing 404**

Lines 24–29 convert all fetch errors to 404, masking real failures (400 on bad request, 409 on conflict, auth errors, network issues). Since the API endpoint returns distinct status codes (400 for missing extensionId, 404 for not found, 409 for other errors), these should be preserved in the error response. Only use 404 when the fetch actually succeeds but no data is returned.

<details>
<summary>Suggested fix</summary>

```diff
-if (error.value || !data.value) {
-  throw createError({
-    statusCode: 404,
-    statusMessage: t("publish.errors.notFound"),
-  })
-}
+if (error.value) {
+  throw createError({
+    statusCode: error.value.statusCode ?? 500,
+    statusMessage: error.value.statusMessage ?? t("publish.errors.generic"),
+  })
+}
+
+if (!data.value) {
+  throw createError({
+    statusCode: 404,
+    statusMessage: t("publish.errors.notFound"),
+  })
+}
```
</details>

error.value.statusCode || error.value.status || 500, statusMessage:
error.value.message || t("publish.errors.fetchFailed") })) and only throw a 404
when there is no error but data.value is falsy (throw createError({ statusCode:

Perfect. Now I have everything I need. Let me compile the specification.

## Specification: Profile / My Workspace Page

### 1. Page Layout

**Route structure:** `/profile` with query params for section and settings tab.

- **URL patterns:**
  - `/profile?section=installed` (default)
  - `/profile?section=published|drafts|saved|activity`
  - `/profile?section=settings&tab=profile|notifications|tokens`

**Layout (page.tsx):**
- Server-side page component that checks auth, redirects to `/sign-in` if no session
- Fetches current user from `users` table (id, name, email, bio, defaultDeptId, createdAt)
- Always loads hero stats via `getProfileStats()`
- Lazy-loads section data only when that section is active (prevents N+1 queries for inactive sections)
- Returns main layout: hero at top, then two-column flex with left sidebar nav + right content area
- Hero renders above tabs; sections/settings swap in the right column

**Section rail (SectionRail):** Left sidebar with 6 links (installed, published, drafts, saved, activity, settings), icons from lucide-react, styled as nav buttons with active highlight.

### 2. Sections (Activity / Drafts / Installed / Published / Saved)

#### **Installed** (`SectionInstalled`)
- Renders list of user's active installs (uninstalledAt IS NULL)
- Displays: name, installedVersion, category badge
- Query: `getInstalledForUser(userId)` → `ProfileInstalledRow[]`
  - Joins `installs` → `extensions`
  - Orders by `installs.installedAt DESC` (most recent first)
  - Returns: extensionId, slug, name, category, iconColor, installedVersion, installedAt
- Empty state: icon + title + body + "Browse marketplace" link to `/extensions`

#### **Published** (`SectionPublished`)
- Renders list of extensions published by user (visibility = "published")
- Displays: name, latestVersion, downloadsCount (formatted with Intl.NumberFormat), starsAvg (★ suffix when > 0), category badge
- Query: `getPublishedForUser(userId)` → `ProfilePublishedRow[]`
  - Joins `extensions` → `extensionVersions` (status = "ready")
  - Orders by `extensions.publishedAt DESC`, then `extensionVersions.publishedAt DESC`
  - De-dups client-side by extensionId (DISTINCT ON not exposed cleanly in Drizzle)
  - Returns: extensionId, slug, name, category, iconColor, latestVersion, downloadsCount, starsAvg (string!), ratingsCount
- Empty state: icon + title + body + "Publish an extension" link to `/publish/new`

#### **Drafts** (`SectionDrafts`)
- Renders extensions with visibility = "draft"
- Displays: name, slug (monospace), latestStatus (only shows "scanning" or "rejected", hides "pending"/"ready" as noisy)
- Query: `getDraftsForUser(userId)` → `ProfileDraftRow[]`
  - Joins `extensions` → `extensionVersions`
  - Orders by `extensions.updatedAt DESC`, then `extensionVersions.createdAt DESC`
  - De-dups by extensionId
  - Returns: extensionId, slug, name, category, iconColor, updatedAt, latestStatus (nullable)
- Links to `/publish/{extensionId}/edit`
- Empty state: icon + title + body + "Publish an extension" link

#### **Saved** (`SectionSaved`)
- Renders user's saved extensions (via system collection with kind = "saved")
- Displays: name, slug (monospace), category badge, with bookmark icon
- Query: `getSavedForUser(userId)` → `ProfileSavedRow[]`
  - Joins `collectionItems` → `collections` (systemKind = "saved") → `extensions`
  - Orders by `collectionItems.addedAt DESC`
  - Returns: extensionId, slug, name, category, iconColor, savedAt
- Links to `/extensions/{slug}`
- Empty state: icon + title + body + "Browse marketplace" link

#### **Activity** (`SectionActivity`)
- Renders chronological feed of user events (installs, publishes, ratings)
- Pulls from three sources in parallel, merges, sorts DESC by timestamp, takes latest 20 items
  1. **Installs:** `installs` where `installs.userId = userId`, joined with `extensions`
  2. **Published versions:** `extensionVersions` where `extensions.publisherUserId = userId` AND visibility = "published" AND status = "ready"
  3. **Ratings:** `ratings` where `ratings.userId = userId`, joined with `extensions`
- Query: `getActivityForUser(userId)` → `ProfileActivityEvent[]`
  - Union type with three variants: `{ kind: "installed" | "published" | "rated", at: Date, ... }`
  - Returns union of: `{ kind, at, extensionId, slug, name, version?, stars? }`
- Event UI: icon + verb + link to extension + metadata (version or star count)
  - "installed {name} v1.0"
  - "published {name} v2.1"
  - "rated {name} ★★★★★"
- Empty state: clock icon + "No activity yet" + body

### 3. ProfileHero

Displays at the top of every view. Shows:
- **Avatar:** 72px circle with color-coded initials (from name or email)
  - Initials logic: split name on whitespace, take first letter of each word, max 2 chars, uppercase
  - Fallback: if name is empty/whitespace, use email[0]
- **Name:** user's name if set and non-empty, else email (truncate with ellipsis if long)
- **Meta row:** "Senior Engineer" · {deptLabel or "No department"} · "Joined {date}"
  - deptLabel: uses `deptPath()` to get full breadcrumb ("Design · Systems" etc), joins with " · "
  - Joined date: `Intl.DateTimeFormat` with locale, format "Apr 2024" / "2024年4月"
- **Stats:** (only if stats are provided) 4-column breakdown
  - Installed count (formatted with locale-aware NumberFormat)
  - Published count
  - Total installs of my extensions
  - Average rating of my extensions (★ suffix, or "—" if no ratings)

Props: `{ name, email, joinedLabel, deptLabel, stats }`

### 4. Settings Form

**Form (`ProfileSettingsForm`):**
- Uses React hook state + `useTransition` + `useFormState`-ish pattern
- Fields (2-column grid on desktop, 1-column on mobile):
  1. **Name** (text input, required, min 1 / max 80 chars)
  2. **Email** (read-only, disabled input)
  3. **Department** (select dropdown, optional, flattened hierarchy with indentation)
  4. **Joined** (read-only, displays formatted date)
  5. **Bio** (textarea, optional, max 280 chars, 3 rows)
- Departments are flattened client-side from DEPARTMENTS constant using recursive function, rendered with indent + "└ " prefix
- **Submit button:** "Save changes" or "Saving…" (pending state), disabled during submit
- **Status messages:** 
  - "Profile saved" (green, dismisses after a moment or on next change)
  - Errors: "Please sign in again" | "Some fields need attention" | "We couldn't save…" (generic fallback)
- Posts to server action `updateProfile(raw)` which validates against `ProfileFormSchema`, returns `UpdateProfileResult`

**Validation (Zod `ProfileFormSchema`):**
```typescript
{
  name: string, min 1, max 80
  defaultDeptId: string, max 120, default ""
  bio: string, max 280, default ""
}
```

Empty strings for optional fields are converted to `null` in the DB insert.

**Server action (`lib/actions/user.ts`):**
```typescript
async function updateProfile(raw: ProfileFormValues): Promise<UpdateProfileResult>
  → checks session
  → parses with schema
  → updates users table (name, defaultDeptId, bio)
  → returns { ok: true } or { ok: false, error: "unauthenticated" | "invalid_input" }
```

### 5. Server Queries Needed (Ported Functions)

All need new endpoints in Nuxt (no existing equivalents in the Nuxt codebase):

| Function | Input | Output | Query type |
|----------|-------|--------|-----------|
| `getProfileStats` | userId: string | `{ installedCount: number, publishedCount: number, totalInstallsOfMine: number, avgRatingOfMine: number \| null }` | Two parallel aggregates (installs.count, extensions.sum) |
| `getInstalledForUser` | userId: string | `ProfileInstalledRow[]` | JOIN installs → extensions, filter uninstalledAt IS NULL |
| `getPublishedForUser` | userId: string | `ProfilePublishedRow[]` | JOIN extensions → extensionVersions (status="ready"), DISTINCT ON extensionId, client-side dedup |
| `getDraftsForUser` | userId: string | `ProfileDraftRow[]` | JOIN extensions → extensionVersions, filter visibility="draft", client-side dedup |
| `getSavedForUser` | userId: string | `ProfileSavedRow[]` | JOIN collectionItems → collections (systemKind="saved") → extensions |
| `getActivityForUser` | userId: string | `ProfileActivityEvent[]` | Three parallel queries (installs, versions, ratings), merged and sorted, top 20 |

Note: `ProfileFormSchema` and `updateProfile` already exist in validators/profile.ts and lib/actions/user.ts (mostly no changes).

### 6. Loading States

- **Original:** No Suspense boundaries shown; page.tsx awaits all queries at component level before rendering
- **Skeleton/fallback UI:** None visible in the code (pages are either fully rendered or error page)
- **For Nuxt port:** You'll want to add skeleton loaders or fallback UI for sections since data loads client-side; consider using vee-validate's `pending` state for the form submit button

### 7. i18n Keys (profile.*)

```

profile.role = "Senior Engineer"
profile.deptUnset = "No department"
profile.joined = "Joined {date}" (interpolates `date` param)

profile.stats.installed = "installed"

profile.settings.tabs.profile = "Profile"

### 8. React ↔ Vue Incompatibilities to Flag

1. **Server actions (`"use server"`):** Next.js pattern. In Nuxt, create API routes (`/server/api/profile.post.ts` or similar) that return `{ ok: boolean, error?: string }`. Call via `$fetch('/api/profile', { method: 'POST', body: formData })`.

2. **`useTransition()`:** React hook. In Nuxt+vee-validate, use `isSubmitting` from form context or `ref(false)` to track pending state.

3. **`useFormState()`:** React hook for form mutations. Nuxt+vee-validate handles this via `handleSubmit()` callback and error bag.

4. **RSC (React Server Components):** Next.js renders page.tsx on the server. In Nuxt, you're on the client; data fetches happen via `useFetch()` or `$fetch()` with `await` at component mount.

5. **Parallel `Promise.all()` queries:** Works the same in Vue; just wrap in `await` at the start of `setup()` or use `Promise.all()` inside a composable.

6. **Locale/translation:** Next.js uses `next-intl` server hooks. Nuxt uses `useI18n()` in components (client-side), so pass locale as part of query string or URL if needed.

7. **Navigation:** Next.js `Link` with `href={{ pathname, query }}` object. Nuxt uses `nuxt-link :to="{ name: 'profile', query: { section: 'drafts' } }"` or `$router.push()`.

8. **`"use client"` directives:** Not needed in Nuxt; components are client-side by default unless you explicitly use `defineServerComponent()`.

---

That covers the contract. You have the queries, types, validation schemas, i18n keys, and the layout/data flow. The Nuxt port will need:
- 5 new server query functions (profile stats, installed, published, drafts, saved, activity)
- 1 POST endpoint for profile updates
- A page component with tabs/sections swapped client-side
- vee-validate for form handling instead of React hooks

## Component Contracts for `[slug].vue` Split (7 Components)

### ExtHero

**Props** (input from parent):
- `ext: ExtensionDetail` — full extension object (id, slug, name, nameZh, tagline, taglineZh, description, descriptionZh, deptId, iconEmoji, iconColor, badge, category, starsAvg, downloadsCount, scope, licenseSpdx, homepageUrl, repoUrl)
- `locale: Locale` — "en" or "zh" for i18n and relative date formatting
- `latestVersion?: string | null` — semantic version tag (e.g., "1.2.3")
- `publishedAt?: Date | null` — ISO date of last publish, used for relative time
- `shareUrl: string` — fully formed URL for share button
- `shareLabel: string` — e.g., "Share"
- `copiedLabel: string` — e.g., "Copied"
- `verifiedLabel: string` — "Official" badge label
- `ratingLabel: string` — e.g., "Rating"
- `downloadsLabel: string` — e.g., "Downloads"
- `versionLabel: string` — e.g., "Version"
- `updatedLabel: string` — e.g., "Updated"

**What it renders** — full-width header block with emoji icon (styled with gradient background), extension name + badge + byline, tagline/description, stats grid (rating, downloads, version, updated date), action button row (InstallButton, SaveButton, ShareButton).

**Behavior** — purely presentational; passes through to InstallButton, SaveButton, ShareButton (handled as child components). Computes relative time ("today", "3d ago", "2mo ago") from publishedAt.

**Server endpoints touched** — none (data pre-fetched by parent page).

---

### ExtAboutCard

**Props**:
- `ext: ExtensionDetail` — subset used: licenseSpdx, homepageUrl, repoUrl, slug
- `locale: Locale` — for relative date formatting
- `latestVersion?: string | null` — displays as "v1.2.3"
- `bundleSize?: bigint | null` — byte size, formatted as KB/MB
- `publishedAt?: Date | null` — for relative time display
- `labels: { title, publisher, version, size, license, updated, scope }: object` — all label strings
- `scopeValue: string` — localized scope label (e.g., "Global", "Local", "App")

**What it renders** — right-side card (sticky on desktop). Definition list with 6 rows: Publisher (slug prefix), Version, Size, License, Updated (relative), Scope. Optional footer with safe links to homepage and repo (stripped of protocol for display).

**Behavior** — purely presentational. Validates URLs (only http/https allowed). Formats bytes to "123 KB" / "1.2 MB". Computes relative time like ExtHero.

**Server endpoints touched** — none.

---

### ExtTabs

**Props**:
- `tabs: TabPanel[]` — array of `{ key: string; label: string; content: React.ReactNode | Vue VNode }`
- `defaultTab?: string` — which tab to show initially (defaults to first tab's key)

**What it renders** — horizontal tab bar (horizontally scrollable), one panel shown at a time. Tab bar has underline indicator on active tab, hover states, focus-visible outline.

**Behavior** — client-side tab state management. Clicking a tab shows its content panel. No server interaction.

**Server endpoints touched** — none.

---

### ExtTabs Content — What Goes Into Each Tab

The Nuxt page must build 4 tab panels and pass them to ExtTabs:

1. **Overview** — README markdown (via Markdown component) + tags section. **Data source**: `ext.readmeMd`, `ext.tagIds` from `extension-detail.get.ts`.

2. **Setup** — Install command block + requirements (compatibility list). **Data source**: `ext.compatibilityJson` (parsed as `Record<string, unknown>`), hand-formatted to `string[]` rows.

3. **Versions** — Version history list with changelog. **Data source**: `versions` from `extension-detail.get.ts` (array of `{version, changelog, status, publishedAt}`). First item is labeled "CURRENT". Locale-aware changelog selection (prefer changelogZh if locale=zh).

4. **Reviews** — Empty placeholder (disabled submit CTA). **Data source**: none (placeholder only).

---

### ExtRelatedList

**Props**:
- `related: RelatedExtension[]` — array of `{ id, slug, name, nameZh, iconEmoji, iconColor, starsAvg }`
- `locale: Locale` — for name selection (nameZh vs name)
- `title: string` — card header label

**What it renders** — card with vertical list of related extensions. Each item: emoji icon (in small colored box), name, publisher (slug prefix) + star rating. Links to `/extensions/{slug}`. Hides entirely if list is empty.

**Behavior** — purely presentational. No interactivity beyond links.

**Server endpoints touched** — none (data pre-fetched).

---

### InstallCommand

**Props**:
- `command: string` — e.g., "agentcenter install my-skill"
- `copyLabel: string` — e.g., "Copy"
- `copiedLabel: string` — e.g., "Copied"

**What it renders** — dark terminal-like code block (monospace, dark background). Shows `$ {command}`. Copy button on the right (state-aware: "Copy" → "✓ Copied").

**Behavior** — click button → copies command to clipboard via `navigator.clipboard.writeText()`. Shows "Copied" for 1.4 seconds, then reverts. Gracefully no-ops if clipboard API unavailable.

**Server endpoints touched** — none (client-only).

---

### ShareButton

**Props**:
- `url: string` — full URL to share (e.g., "https://app.example.com/extensions/my-skill")
- `label: string` — e.g., "Share"
- `copiedLabel: string` — e.g., "Copied"

**What it renders** — pill button with share icon (Share2 from lucide). Text changes when copied.

**Behavior** — click → attempts native `navigator.share({ url })` (iOS/Android). If not available or user dismisses, falls back to `navigator.clipboard.writeText(url)`. Shows "Copied" state for 1.4 seconds. Silently ignores errors (AbortError on user dismiss, clipboard blocked, etc.).

**Server endpoints touched** — none (client-only).

---

### SaveButton

**Props**:
- `extensionId: string` — UUID of the extension to save
- `variant?: "icon" | "pill"` — styling variant ("icon" = small icon-only button, "pill" = button with label)

**What it renders** — button with folder icon. Pill variant also shows label ("Add to Group" or "Saved"). Icon changes on save (Folder → FolderCheck, color changes to accent/primary).

**Behavior** — click → if unauthenticated, redirects to `/sign-in`. If authenticated, calls `POST /api/internal/installs` with `{ extensionId }`. On success, icon/label change to "Saved" state for 3 seconds. Loading state while request in flight (disabled:opacity-60). No explicit error UI (console.error only).

**Server endpoints touched**:
- `POST /api/internal/installs`
- **Body**: `{ extensionId: string }`
- **Returns**: `{ ok: true, ...result }` or throws 404/422/500
- **Internal logic** (server-side): gets or creates system collection (kind="saved"), upserts collection item. Auth via `requireUser()`.

## Porting Caveats: React → Vue

1. **InstallButton (already exists in Nuxt, differs from SaveButton)** — Next.js SaveButton is the Save action (folder icon). Nuxt's InstallButton is the Install action (download icon). Two separate components in Next.js; Nuxt already has InstallButton separate. Keep them split.

2. **Tab content as VNodes** — Next.js passes JSX directly (`content: <OverviewPanel ... />`). Nuxt passes computed/async content. The `ExtTabs` component must handle both Template strings and component slots, or the page must pre-render content into objects. Simplest: pass `:content` as a component definition + props object, or use Markdown.vue directly.

3. **Markdown rendering** — Next.js MarkdownContent is server-side rendered. Nuxt Markdown.vue is a client component using markdown-it + DOMPurify. Both safe; no port issue, just different strategy.

4. **Relative date formatting** — ExtHero and ExtAboutCard both compute relative times (formatRelative). Move this to a shared composable (`useRelativeDate(date, locale)`) to avoid duplication.

5. **Safe URL validation** — Next.js has `safeExternalUrl()` utility. Nuxt needs the same; add to shared utils. Both platforms only allow http/https.

6. **Auth redirects** — SaveButton redirects to `/sign-in` on 401. Nuxt router.push() must use `localePath()` to respect locale prefix (e.g., `/zh/sign-in` not `/sign-in`). Already handled in InstallButton.vue example; replicate in SaveButton.

7. **Compatibility rows formatting** — Next.js compatRows() function formats compatibilityJson. Move to a utility function (shared composable or server helper) so Nuxt can call it server-side when building Setup tab content.

---

**Summary**: 158-line monolith splits cleanly into ExtHero (header + stats + action buttons) | (ExtTabs with 4 panels) + (ExtAboutCard + ExtRelatedList in sidebar). All child components are presentational except SaveButton (handles POST). Tab content (Overview/Setup/Versions/Reviews) stays in the page and is passed down as TabPanel objects. No deep auth or API complexity except SaveButton's 401→signin redirect, which is already pattern-matched in InstallButton.vue.
```

import { z } from "zod";

// Profile form for the Settings → Profile sub-tab. Email is read-only at the
// schema level — we don't accept it here. Department is a free-form string
// (validated against DEPARTMENTS at the UI layer; the column has no FK so a
// stray value would land as a logical-only reference).
export const PROFILE_NAME_MIN = 1;
export const PROFILE_NAME_MAX = 80;
export const PROFILE_DEPT_ID_MAX = 120;
export const PROFILE_BIO_MAX = 280;

// Zod 4: `.default(...)` already treats `undefined` as optional input, so
// chaining `.optional().default(...)` is redundant.
export const ProfileFormSchema = z.object({
  name: z.string().min(PROFILE_NAME_MIN).max(PROFILE_NAME_MAX),
  defaultDeptId: z.string().max(PROFILE_DEPT_ID_MAX).default(""),
  bio: z.string().max(PROFILE_BIO_MAX).default(""),
});

export type ProfileFormValues = z.infer<typeof ProfileFormSchema>;

import { db } from "@/lib/db/client";

export type ProfileInstalledRow = {
  extensionId: string;

export type ProfileSavedRow = {
  extensionId: string;
  slug: string;
  name: string;
  category: string;
  iconColor: string | null;
  savedAt: Date;
};

export async function getSavedForUser(
  userId: string,
): Promise<ProfileSavedRow[]> {
  // Join through `collection_items` rather than reading the collection id
  // first — one JOIN is cheaper than two round-trips, and a user without a
  // saved collection simply returns no rows.
  return db
    .select({
      extensionId: extensions.id,
      slug: extensions.slug,
      name: extensions.name,
      category: extensions.category,
      iconColor: extensions.iconColor,
      savedAt: collectionItems.addedAt,
    })
    .from(collectionItems)
    .innerJoin(
      collections,
      and(
        eq(collections.id, collectionItems.collectionId),
        eq(collections.ownerUserId, userId),
        eq(collections.systemKind, "saved"),
      ),
    )
    .innerJoin(extensions, eq(extensions.id, collectionItems.extensionId))
    .orderBy(desc(collectionItems.addedAt));
}

export type ProfileDraftRow = {
  extensionId: string;
  slug: string;
  name: string;
  category: string;
  iconColor: string | null;
  updatedAt: Date;
  latestStatus: string | null;
};

export async function getDraftsForUser(
  userId: string,
): Promise<ProfileDraftRow[]> {
  // "Draft" = extension.visibility == "draft". Latest version's status
  // surfaces why a draft is stuck (e.g. "scanning", "rejected") so the
  // row can mirror the publish dashboard's status pill.
  const rows = await db
    .select({
      extensionId: extensions.id,
      slug: extensions.slug,
      name: extensions.name,
      category: extensions.category,
      iconColor: extensions.iconColor,
      updatedAt: extensions.updatedAt,
      latestStatus: extensionVersions.status,
    })
    .from(extensions)
    .leftJoin(
      extensionVersions,
      eq(extensionVersions.extensionId, extensions.id),
    )
    .where(
      and(
        eq(extensions.publisherUserId, userId),
        eq(extensions.visibility, "draft"),
      ),
    )
    .orderBy(
      desc(extensions.updatedAt),
      desc(extensionVersions.createdAt),
    );

  const seen = new Set<string>();
  const out: ProfileDraftRow[] = [];
  for (const r of rows) {
    if (seen.has(r.extensionId)) continue;
    seen.add(r.extensionId);
    out.push(r);
  }
  return out;
}

export async function getInstalledForUser(
  userId: string,
): Promise<ProfileInstalledRow[]> {
  // Active installs only — `uninstalledAt IS NULL`. Order by `installedAt
  // DESC` matches the design's "most recently installed first" sort.
  return db
    .select({
      extensionId: extensions.id,
      slug: extensions.slug,
      name: extensions.name,
      category: extensions.category,
      iconColor: extensions.iconColor,
      installedVersion: installs.version,
      installedAt: installs.installedAt,
    })
    .from(installs)
    .innerJoin(extensions, eq(extensions.id, installs.extensionId))
    .where(and(eq(installs.userId, userId), isNull(installs.uninstalledAt)))
    .orderBy(desc(installs.installedAt));
}

"use server";

import { eq } from "drizzle-orm";

import { getSession } from "@/lib/auth/session";
import { db } from "@/lib/db/client";
import { users } from "@/lib/db/schema/auth";
import {
  ProfileFormSchema,
  type ProfileFormValues,
} from "@/lib/validators/profile";

export async function updateDepartment(
  deptId: string,
): Promise<{ ok: boolean; error?: string }> {
  const session = await getSession();
  if (!session) return { ok: false, error: "Not signed in." };

  await db
    .update(users)
    .set({ defaultDeptId: deptId })
    .where(eq(users.id, session.user.id));

  return { ok: true };
}

export type UpdateProfileResult =
  | { ok: true }
  | { ok: false; error: "unauthenticated" | "invalid_input"; detail?: string };

export async function updateProfile(
  raw: ProfileFormValues,
): Promise<UpdateProfileResult> {
  const session = await getSession();
  if (!session) return { ok: false, error: "unauthenticated" };

  const parsed = ProfileFormSchema.safeParse(raw);
  if (!parsed.success) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      error: "invalid_input",
      detail: parsed.error.issues.map((i) => i.message).join("; "),
    };
  }
  const data = parsed.data;

  await db
    .update(users)
    .set({
      name: data.name,
      defaultDeptId: data.defaultDeptId === "" ? null : data.defaultDeptId,
      bio: data.bio === "" ? null : data.bio,
    })
    .where(eq(users.id, session.user.id));

  return { ok: true };
}

export type ProfileStats = {
  installedCount: number;
  publishedCount: number;
  totalInstallsOfMine: number;
  avgRatingOfMine: number | null;
};

export async function getProfileStats(userId: string): Promise<ProfileStats> {
  // Two small aggregates, run in parallel. Each is cheap (covered by
  // existing indexes on installs.userId and extensions.publisherUserId).
  // We avoid a single CTE because the failure mode (one half goes slow)
  // is easier to diagnose split, and Postgres can parallelize anyway.
  const [installedAgg, pubAgg] = await Promise.all([
    db
      .select({ c: sql<number>`count(*)::int` })
      .from(installs)
      .where(and(eq(installs.userId, userId), isNull(installs.uninstalledAt))),
    db
      .select({
        count: sql<number>`count(*)::int`,
        totalInstalls: sql<number>`coalesce(sum(${extensions.downloadsCount}),0)::int`,

import { betterAuth } from "better-auth"
import { drizzleAdapter } from "better-auth/adapters/drizzle"
import type { H3Event } from "h3"

import {
  accounts,
  sessions,
  users,
  verifications,
} from "~~/shared/db/schema/auth"

function makeAuth() {
  const db = useDb()
  return betterAuth({
    database: drizzleAdapter(db, {
      provider: "pg",
      schema: {
        user: users,
        session: sessions,
        account: accounts,
        verification: verifications,
      },
    }),
    emailAndPassword: { enabled: true },
    user: {
      additionalFields: {
        locale: {
          type: "string",
          required: false,
          defaultValue: "en",
          input: false,
        },
        themePreference: {
          type: "string",
          required: false,
          defaultValue: "ivory",
          input: false,
        },
        defaultDeptId: {
          type: "string",
          required: false,
          input: false,
        },
      },
    },
  })
}

type AuthInstance = ReturnType<typeof makeAuth>

let _auth: AuthInstance | undefined

export function useAuthServer(): AuthInstance {
  if (!_auth) _auth = makeAuth()
  return _auth
}

type SessionPayload = Awaited<
  ReturnType<AuthInstance["api"]["getSession"]>
>
export type SessionUser = NonNullable<SessionPayload>["user"]

function toFetchHeaders(raw: Record<string, string | string[] | undefined>): Headers {
  const headers = new Headers()
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(raw)) {
    if (value === undefined) continue
    headers.append(key, Array.isArray(value) ? value.join(", ") : value)
  }
  return headers
}

export async function getSessionUser(event: H3Event): Promise<SessionUser | null> {
  const auth = useAuthServer()
  const session = await auth.api.getSession({
    headers: toFetchHeaders(getRequestHeaders(event)),
  })
  return session?.user ?? null
}

export async function requireUser(event: H3Event): Promise<SessionUser> {
  const user = await getSessionUser(event)
  if (!user) {
    throw createError({ statusCode: 401, statusMessage: "Unauthenticated" })
  }
  return user
}

>\n            {{ \"└ \".repeat(opt.depth) }}{{ opt.label }}\n          </option>\n        </select>\n      </PubField>\n\n      <PubField :label=\"t('profile.settings.fields.joined')\">\n        <Input :model-value=\"joinedLabel\" disabled />\n      </PubField>\n    </div>\n\n    <PubField :label=\"t('profile.settings.fields.bio')\">\n      <Textarea v-model=\"form.bio\" (raw as ProfileSectionKey)\n    : \"installed\"\n})\n\ninterface MeResponse {\n  user: {\n    id: string\n    email: string\n    name: string | null\n    bio: string | null\n    defaultDeptId: string | null\n    createdAt: string\n  }\n  stats: ProfileStats\n}\n\ntype SectionResponse =\n  | { section: \"installed\"; rows: ProfileInstalledRow[] }\n  | { section: \"published\"; rows: ProfilePublishedRow[] }\n  | { section: \"drafts\"; rows: ProfileDraftRow[] }\n  | { section: \"saved\"; rows: ProfileSavedRow[] }\n  | { section: \"activity\"; rows: ProfileActivityEvent[] }\n\nconst { data: me, refresh: refreshMe } = await useFetch<MeResponse>(\n  \"/api/internal/profile/me\",\n)\n\nconst sectionQuery = computed(() =>\n  active.value === \"settings\" ? null : { section: active.value },\n)\n\nconst { data: section } = await useFetch<SectionResponse | null>(\n  \"/api/internal/profile/section\",\n  {\n    query: sectionQuery,\n    // Skip the fetch when on the Settings tab.\n    immediate: active.value !== \"settings\",\n  },\n)\n</script>\n\n<template>\n  <div class=\"px-6 py-8 max-w-6xl mx-auto\">\n    <ProfileHero\n      v-if=\"me\"\n      :name=\"me.user.name\"\n      :email=\"me.user.email\"\n      :default-dept-id=\"me.user.defaultDeptId\"\n      :created-at=\"me.user.createdAt\"\n      :stats=\"me.stats\"\n    />\n\n    <div class=\"mt-6 grid gap-6 md:grid-cols-[220px_1fr]\">\n      <SectionRail :active=\"active\" />\n\n      <main class=\"min-w-0\">\n        <h2 class=\"mb-4 font-serif text-xl text-(--color-ink)\">\n          {{ t(`profile.sections.${active}`) }}\n        </h2>\n\n        <SectionInstalled\n          v-if=\"active === 'installed' && section?.section === 'installed'\"\n          :rows=\"section.rows\"\n        />\n        <SectionPublished\n          v-else-if=\"active === 'published' && section?.section === 'published'\"\n          :rows=\"section.rows\"\n        />\n        <SectionDrafts\n          v-else-if=\"active === 'drafts' && section?.section === 'drafts'\"\n          :rows=\"section.rows\"\n        />\n        <SectionSaved\n          v-else-if=\"active === 'saved' && section?.section === 'saved'\"\n          :rows=\"section.rows\"\n        />\n        <SectionActivity\n          v-else-if=\"active === 'activity' && section?.section === 'activity'\"\n          :rows=\"section.rows\"\n        />\n        <ProfileSettingsForm\n          v-else-if=\"active === 'settings' && me\"\n          :initial-name=\"me.user.name ?? ''\"\n          :email=\"me.user.email\"\n          :initial-dept-id=\"me.user.defaultDeptId ?? ''\"\n          :initial-bio=\"me.user.bio ?? ''\"\n          :created-at=\"me.user.createdAt\"\n          @saved=\"refreshMe\"\n        />\n      </main>\n    </div>\n  </div>\n</template>\n"

import { and, eq, ne, sql } from "drizzle-orm"
import {
  extensions,
  extensionTags,
  extensionVersions,
} from "~~/shared/db/schema"

export async function getExtensionBySlug(slug: string) {
  const db = useDb()
  const [row] = await db
    .select({
      id: extensions.id,
      slug: extensions.slug,
      category: extensions.category,
      badge: extensions.badge,
      scope: extensions.scope,
      funcCat: extensions.funcCat,
      subCat: extensions.subCat,
      l2: extensions.l2,
      deptId: extensions.deptId,
      iconEmoji: extensions.iconEmoji,
      iconColor: extensions.iconColor,
      name: extensions.name,
      nameZh: extensions.nameZh,
      tagline: extensions.tagline,
      taglineZh: extensions.taglineZh,
      description: extensions.description,
      descriptionZh: extensions.descriptionZh,
      readmeMd: extensions.readmeMd,
      homepageUrl: extensions.homepageUrl,
      repoUrl: extensions.repoUrl,
      licenseSpdx: extensions.licenseSpdx,
      compatibilityJson: extensions.compatibilityJson,
      permissions: extensions.permissions,
      downloadsCount: extensions.downloadsCount,
      starsAvg: extensions.starsAvg,
      ratingsCount: extensions.ratingsCount,
      publishedAt: extensions.publishedAt,
      publisherUserId: extensions.publisherUserId,
      ownerOrgId: extensions.ownerOrgId,
      tagIds: sql<string[]>`coalesce(array_agg(${extensionTags.tagId}) FILTER (WHERE ${extensionTags.tagId} IS NOT NULL), '{}')`,
    })
    .from(extensions)
    .leftJoin(extensionTags, eq(extensionTags.extensionId, extensions.id))
    .where(
      and(eq(extensions.slug, slug), eq(extensions.visibility, "published")),
    )
    .groupBy(extensions.id)
  return row ?? null
}

function findOgImageComponents(dir) {
  const components = [];
  for (const componentDir of defaultComponentDirs) {
    const ogImageDir = join(dir, "components", componentDir);
    if (existsSync(ogImageDir)) {
      const files = readdirSync(ogImageDir, { withFileTypes: true });
      for (const file of files) {
        if (file.isFile() && file.name.endsWith(".vue"))
          components.push(join(ogImageDir, file.name));
      }
    }
  }
  return components;
}
function globFiles(dir, pattern, exclude = []) {
  const results = [];
  function walk(currentDir) {
    if (!existsSync(currentDir))
      return;
    const entries = readdirSync(currentDir, { withFileTypes: true });
    for (const entry of entries) {
      const fullPath = join(currentDir, entry.name);
      if (exclude.some((re) => re.test(fullPath)))
        continue;
      if (entry.isDirectory()) {
        walk(fullPath);
      } else if (entry.isFile() && pattern.test(entry.name)) {
        results.push(fullPath);
      }
    }
  }
  walk(dir);
  return results;

After two attempted layouts I fell back to the module's bundled `Frame` template (still gets per-page `title` / `description` props). The component file moves are gone; only `nuxt.config.ts` + two `defineOgImageComponent("Frame", …)` calls remain. Noted in the commit body as deferred follow-up.
